SICAL Sangguniang Bayan Member Sagfiay, Province of Camarines Sur Office of the Sangguniang Member Dear SB Member Sical: This has reference to your letter dated June 10, 2024, requesting this Department's legal opinion on who is the qualified official to temporarily take the position in case the Secretary to the Sanggunian Bayan is on official travel over the conduct of a Sanggunian Bayan Regular Session. At the outset, it is to be noted that the Secretary to the Sanggunian holds a crucial role in ensuring the efficient and smooth operation and documentation of legislative activities. In instances where the Secretary to the Sanggunan is unable to carry out his functions due to official or personal leave and other legal reasons, it is paramount to designate a qualified employee to temporarily assume such functions to ensure that the operations of the Sanggunian are not hindered. Going now to the issue—who is the qualified official to temporarily assume the functions of the Secretary to the Sanggunian in instances where the Secretary to the Sanggunian is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties due to legal reasons such as leave of absence. Relevant to the issue at hand is the Civil Service Commission (CSC) guidelines on designations. Hence, attention is respectfully directed to Section 13 (c), Rule IV, 2017 Omnibus Rules on Appointments and other Human Resource Actions. Pertinent portion of which reads: I. 2. 3. "Designation shall be governed by the following rules: Employees to be designated should hold permanent appointments to career positions. Designees can only be designated to positions within the level they are currently occupying. Employees holding first level positions cannot be designated to perform the duties of second level positions except in meritorious cases as determined by the CSC Regional Office upon request for exemption by the agency concerned, such as organizational set-up, calamity, and due to exigency of the service. This exception shall not apply to positions involving supervisory and executive managerial functions. Division Chiefs may be designated to perform the duties of second level executive/managerial or third level positions. For positions with incumbents who temporarily cannot perform the duties of the position (due to vacation or sick leave, study leave, scholarship, maternity leave, special assignments), the designation should be synchronized with the absence "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

4. of the incumbent, unless earlier revoked or recalled by the appointing officer/authority. However, the designation of employees may be renewed every year in the exigency of the service but not to exceed two (2) years. For positions without incumbents, a designation may be made only for a maximum of one (I) year. However, the designation of employees may be renewed every year in the exigency of the service but not to exceed two (2) years. xxx." Accordingly, in the event that the incumbent Secretary to the Sanggunian Bayan is on leave, the Vice Mayor may designate a qualified employee who possesses the foregoing qualifications and the necessary qualifications as stipulated in the Local Government Codel to temporarily assume the position. This is in consideration that the power of the Vice Mayor to appoint all officials and employees of the Sangguniang bayan subject to the civil service law under Section 445 (a) (2) of the LGC necessarily include the power to designate an acting Secretary to the Sanggunian. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities or the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Very truly yours, By the rity of the Secretary: VICTOR R. LLAMAS Undersecr ary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLAJ ULLLS-LRALLD/jam cc: DIR. ARNALDO E. ESCOBER, CESO V Regional Director, DILG — V (Bicol Region) Regional Government Center Rizal St., Legazpi City "Section 469. Qualifications, Powers and Duties. (a) There shall be a secretary to the sanggunian who shall be a career Official with the rank and salary equal to a head Of department or office. (b) No person shall be appointed secretary to the sanggunian unless he is a citizen Of the Philippines, a resident Of the local government unit concerned, Of good moral character, a holder of a college degree preferably in law, commerce or public administration from a recognized college or university, and a first grade civil service eligible or its equivalent.
